full_prompt_en: A square nighttime landscape photograph shows green aurora curtains rising above jagged snowy mountains and a dark rocky streambed. The upper half is a deep blue-black sky with faint stars and layered clouds. Near the left and center, luminous green bands arc upward and spread into vertical veils, their edges soft and irregular against the dark sky. A cluster of sharp mountain peaks stands just left of center, with narrow strips of snow catching pale light along their ridges. Lower hills continue to the right beneath heavy cloud, fading into shadow. Across the foreground, a cold stream or meltwater channel winds from the lower center toward the middle distance. Its dark surface holds a few muted reflections of green sky light, interrupted by slick black rock and ice. Several large rounded boulders sit close to the lower-left corner, their surfaces lightly dusted with snow. Thin dark trees gather at the foot of the mountains on the far left, giving scale to the open valley. The camera looks low along the channel, making the winding water a path toward the illuminated sky. The aurora provides the most visible light, with a faint warm glow near the distant right horizon and very weak cool light on the snow. Foreground textures remain dark and tactile rather than artificially brightened. The overall composition balances the restless vertical sky light against stable mountain silhouettes and a quiet curved valley floor.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形夜景照片里，绿色极光幕从尖锐雪山和深暗岩石溪谷上方升起。上半部是深蓝黑天空，有隐约星点和层叠云。左侧与中央附近，发亮绿带弯曲向上，散成竖向薄幕，柔软不规则边缘衬着暗空。一簇尖峰立在中心偏左，狭窄积雪沿山脊接住浅光。较低山势向右继续，藏在厚云下，渐入阴影。前景一条清冷溪流或融水沟从下方中央蜿蜒通向中景。深色水面带一点压低的绿色天光反射，被光滑黑岩和冰层打断。几块大圆石靠近左下角，表面薄薄覆雪。左侧远处山脚聚着细深树木，为敞开山谷提供尺度。相机沿水道低望，让弯曲水流成为走向发亮天空的路径。极光提供最明显的光，远右地平线有微弱暖光，雪上则是很弱的冷光。前景肌理保持深暗而可触，没有被人为提得过亮。整体构图让躁动竖向天光同稳定山峰剪影、安静弯曲谷底取得平衡。
style_prompt_en: The nighttime photograph keeps most of the land in deep blue-black shadow while luminous green and turquoise veils animate the upper field. Light has a soft translucent edge in the sky, but hard dark silhouettes and crisp near textures anchor the lower half. Sparse pale highlights follow ridges, ice and wet surfaces without flattening the darkness. A faint warm horizon note offsets the cool dominant palette. The composition uses sweeping vertical light against a low winding line and angular masses, creating scale and movement. Fine low-light grain and restrained exposure preserve the sense of a real cold night rather than a uniformly glowing fantasy scene.
style_prompt_zh: 这种夜景摄影让大部分地面留在深蓝黑阴影中，发亮的绿与青绿薄幕激活上方色域。天空中的光边柔软透明，下半部则由坚硬深剪影和清楚近景肌理稳住。稀疏浅亮痕迹沿棱线、冰面与湿表面延伸，却没有压平黑暗。地平线一点微暖色抵住主导冷调。构图让扫过天空的竖向光与低处弯线、棱角量块相对，产生尺度和运动感。细微低光颗粒与克制曝光保留真实寒夜感，而非处处发亮的奇幻景。
theme_en: Green aurora curtains above jagged snow mountains and a rocky frozen stream

name: Paul Zizka
